The birthplace of Milk Magic churns with chaos. Here, it's not just blood that curdles. A secret map awaits the hero brave enough to enter this overthrown factory.

Dairy Plant features an open map with relatively free movement, though large structures resembling industrial facilities, warehouses and pools of milk serve as major obstacles throughout the stage. Enemy spawns occur from all directions, but their spawns can be affected by the layout—if a solid structure blocks the edge of the screen, enemies will not appear from that direction. Two types of destructibles can spawn in the stage. The first are light sources in the form of lamp posts, which drop random pickups when broken. The second are

, which occasionally appear along rails; once they have taken enough damage, they launch at high speed toward the opposite end of the rail, dealing heavy damage to any enemies they collide with. Trap pizzas, the circular pressure plates found on the ground, can be encountered at set locations throughout the stage. Stepping on one triggers a random map event.

The hyper mode for this map can be unlocked by defeating the Sword Guardian boss (25:00) for the first time. It can also be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "everywhere".
Hyper mode in Dairy Plant has +50% Gold and +10%
